RECRUIT ── メンバーを募集: RECRUIT ── We are looking for members
村に住む。村に通う。: Live in the village. Commute to the village.
村に移住して現場を一緒につくるか、定期的に通って、滞在中に活動を共にするか。関わ: Move to the village and build the field with us, or come regularly and join the work while you are here. There are two ways to take part.
この村で、生き方ごと、共につくる。: Build together in this village — a whole way of life.
5〜10年をかけて、暮らしと社会を一緒につくっていく「始まりの仲間」を2〜3名ほ: We are looking for two or three founding companions to build a way of life and a community together over five to ten years.
本募集では地域おこし協力隊制度を活用予定です。地域要件を満たす方には地域おこし協: We plan to use Japan's Community Revitalization Cooperator (chiiki okoshi kyoryokutai) program for this position. Applicants who meet the residency requirements may be contracted under that program.
業務委託。個人事業主としての開業、もしくは委託先としての法人が必要。: Service contract. You will need to register as a sole proprietor or contract through a company.
無農薬の稲作・畑作補助、大型動物の飼育、複数のプロジェクト運営、村の維持活動、関: Helping with pesticide-free rice and vegetable farming, caring for large animals, running several projects, village upkeep, helping on partner farms, hosting visitors to the village, and more.
契約は本人のみ。年齢は10代後半〜40代半ばまで。農作業・田舎暮らし経験が無くて: The contract is with the individual only. Ages from the late teens to the mid-40s. No experience of farming or rural life is required. Families are welcome to relocate together.
22万円（税込）/月。契約開始は最も早くて2026年10月より。最大3年間、本条: ¥220,000 per month (tax included). The contract can start from October 2026 at the earliest and can be extended on these terms for up to three years. Rice, vegetables, miso, and oil from the farm are provided. Support is available for housing repairs, rent, and activity costs. Contract renewal is decided by the end of January each year.
雇用関係は発生しないため、労働保険・社会保険の適用は無し。国民健康保険・国民年金: As this is not an employment relationship, labor and social insurance do not apply. Please enroll in National Health Insurance and the National Pension yourself.
村内に診療所があります。最寄りの総合病院（会津若松市）まで車で約40分、冬季は1: There is a clinic in the village. The nearest general hospital (in Aizuwakamatsu) is about 40 minutes by car, or around an hour in winter.
保育園と小中学校有り。: There is a nursery school and an elementary and junior high school.
村のアパート、もしくは小野川に整備中の新拠点（R9年秋まで二階と外壁工事を予定）: An apartment in the village, or the new base under development in Onogawa (work on the second floor and exterior walls is planned through autumn 2027). *Shared living in some cases.
12月〜3月ごろまで雪かきが必要です（積雪2〜3メートル）。主に屋敷周りは自分で: Snow shoveling is needed from around December to March (snowfall of 2–3 meters). You will mostly need to clear the snow around your own house.
自家用車が必要です。お持ちでない場合は、中古車の販売行者さんを紹介します。また、: You will need your own car. If you do not have one, we can introduce a used-car dealer. We lend a light truck for farm work.

家族での移住も歓迎しています: Families are welcome to relocate together
衣食住に関わる手仕事に携わりたい方。: People who want to work with their hands on food, clothing, and shelter.
多世代の交流の場づくりに関心がある方。: People interested in creating places where generations mix.
村や集落の方とのご近所付き合いを楽しめる方。: People who enjoy being good neighbors to the village community.
大型動物のお世話にもワクワクできる方。: People who get excited about caring for large animals.
かまど調理や大人数で囲む食卓に興味のある方。: People interested in cooking on a wood stove and sharing meals with a crowd.
自然を相手にする仕事のため、その都度、臨機応変な対応を求められます。: Because the work depends on nature, you will need to adapt as situations arise.
また、地域の特性上、12月〜3月ごろまで雪かきが必要です。雪は最大で2メートルを: Given the region, snow shoveling is needed from around December to March; snow can exceed two meters. In summer, about five days a month go to cutting grass.
コンビニや夜に外食するお店はない地域のため、原則として自炊が基本となります。: There are no convenience stores or places to eat out at night, so cooking for yourself is the norm.
住んで支える ── 大学を休学し、無の会の春の農繁期に住み込みで大活躍した一翔く: Living here to support the farm ── Kazuto, who took a leave from university and was a huge help living on site through Munokai's busy spring season
会津に通い、共にはたらく。: Commute to Aizu and work alongside us.
いまの仕事と暮らしを続けながら、この構想の現場に関わりたい人へ。: For people who want to be part of this project on the ground while keeping their current job and life.
現在、企業さんを含む4組の方々が、この形で関わってくださっています。: Four parties, including companies, are currently involved in this way.
毎月もしくは隔月で会津まで足を運び、共に現場作業や事業づくりを進める。滞在日程は: Come to Aizu every month or every other month to work in the field and build projects together. Stays can fall on weekdays, weekends, or holidays.
田畑の作業、古民家の手入れ、拠点の運営、発信や記録などを行う。滞在期間中は、新鮮: Field work, maintaining old houses, running the bases, communications and record-keeping. During your stay you live communally, cooking with fresh produce from the farm. Depending on the season, you can also join walks and mountain hikes in Oku-Aizu, foraging for wild vegetables and mushrooms, river fishing, local shrine rituals, workshops, and other seasonal and community activities.
会津美里町、または昭和村の宿泊スペースへ。宿の手配は不要。どちらも滞在中はリモー: Stay in our lodging in Aizumisato or Showa Village — no need to book accommodation. Both have coworking space where you can work remotely during your stay.
交通費は自己負担。昭和村は都心部から車で片道4時間前後。冬は道が閉ざされ、予定ど: Travel costs are at your own expense. Showa Village is about four hours by car from central Tokyo. In winter, roads can close and plans may have to change.
興味のある方は、まずは現場へ援農・視察にお越しください。: If you are interested, start by visiting the field to volunteer or look around.
